· Position vs SMA100/200($0.18/$0.22): Below mid/long-term trends, breaking below long-term trend.

· RSI trajectory (48.8→47.8) + Entered oversold territory, continuing below neutral zone.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-0.0010→-0.0010) + Weakness persists, weak trend reversal signal.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Lower band $0.16) + Approaching lower band, 38.05% band width suggests potential volatility expansion.

· Swing resistance ($0.20) + Aligns with SMA20 and Bollinger middle band.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Sideways): 5-day low and 20-day low maintain similar levels.
[Volume & Conclusion]

· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase) + Potential for bounce due to short-term oversold entry, but trend reversal uncertain due to persistent MACD weakness, observe.
